Taylor and Ashe triangle of paid claims

Source: R/reserving_data.R
taylor_ashe_triangle.Rd

The cumulative paid claims of Taylor and Ashe (1983) for ten accident years: the triangle of Mack's (1993) paper on the standard error of the chain ladder.

Usage

taylor_ashe_triangle

Format

A numeric matrix with 10 rows (accident years) and 10 columns (development years), NA for the future.

Source

Taylor, G. C. and Ashe, F. R. (1983). Second moments of estimates of outstanding claims. Journal of Econometrics 23(1), 37-61.

See also

chain_ladder.

Examples

chain_ladder(taylor_ashe_triangle, sigma = "Mack")$total
#>       latest    developed     ultimate         ibnr           se           cv 
#> 3.435809e+07 6.477898e-01 5.303895e+07 1.868086e+07 2.447095e+06 1.309948e-01 
#>   process_se parameter_se 
#> 1.878292e+06 1.568532e+06
